extensionDescription.message: Checks lookalike hostname characters and five visual spelling patterns against registered domains.

permissionNote.message: Leave unchecked to allow it only in this tab.

settingsIntro.message: Hostnames saved with “Always allow this hostname”. Remove one to check it again the next time you open it.

emptyList.message: No saved hostnames. To add one, select “Always allow this hostname” on the warning page and continue.

storageNote.message: Allowed sites and protected domains are stored in this Chrome profile on this device. They are not sent to an external service or synced to other devices.

removalNote.message: Removing a hostname also revokes its tab-only permissions. Pages that are already open will stay open.

noHostnameNote.message: Character differences appear here when a hostname needs your attention.

searchStopped.message: The search results have been hidden.

accessStopped.message: Navigation to this hostname was blocked.

reopenURL.message: Open the original URL again before choosing whether to continue.

warningUnavailable.message: Could not verify this warning. Open the original URL again.

permissionRemoved.message: Removed permission for “$1”. It will be checked the next time you open it.

checkCharacters.message: Check the character differences before continuing.

listBackgroundFailed.message: Could not update allowed sites. Please try again.

pendingMissing.message: This warning has expired. Open the original URL again.

permissionInvalid.message: Could not verify the permission setting.

continueRetry.message: Could not continue. Please try again.

similarDomainReason.message: This hostname resembles a registered domain for $1 ($2). Similarity alone does not mean it is a fake site.

protectionIntro.message: Compares registered domains using five lookalike patterns. Registered domains and their subdomains are excluded from this similarity check. Ordinary misspellings are not checked.

protectionPatterns.message: Patterns: rn / m · 0 / o · 1 / l / i (I) · vv / w · cl / d. Chrome lowercases hostnames, so I is compared as i.

protectionInputHelp.message: Enter ASCII domain names verified on the official site. Separate multiple domains with commas or new lines. Do not include a URL path or wildcard (*).

protectionSaveFailed.message: Could not save protected domains. Your previous settings have been kept. Try again.

protectionInvalid.message: Enter a name and valid ASCII domain names, without a scheme, path, port, credentials or wildcard.

protectionDuplicate.message: This domain is already registered. Edit its existing entry.

protectionLimit.message: You can register up to 200 companies/services and 400 domains.

protectionRuleFailed.message: Chrome could not create a blocking rule for these domains. Your previous settings have been kept.

protectionListPurpose.message: This list supplies reference domains for an additional check of lookalike combinations made from ordinary letters and digits. Destinations are compared with the registered domains using five patterns: rn/m, 0/o, 1/l/i (I), vv/w and cl/d.

protectionListScope.message: Cyrillic characters and listed non-ASCII lookalike letters are checked even when a destination is not on this list. Hostnames you have allowed bypass checks while that permission is active.

protectionListEdit.message: You can add your own companies and services using the fields above, and edit or remove existing entries. Verify each domain on the official website before registering it.
